# Novin Cloud Documentation (مستندات نوین کلاد)

> Official, open-source docs for Novin Cloud services: cloud servers, CDN, DNS, AI gateway, wallet, support, and the free software mirrors at mirror.novin.cloud. Persian (default) with an English locale under /en/.

## Sections
- [Introduction](https://docs.novin.cloud/)
- [Cloud servers](https://docs.novin.cloud/cloud-servers/about): create, access (SSH/RDP/VNC), manage, hourly pricing.
- [CDN](https://docs.novin.cloud/cdn/about): gateways, upstreams & locations, cache TTLs, WAF rules.
- [DNS](https://docs.novin.cloud/dns/about): add domain, records, troubleshooting.
- [AI gateway](https://docs.novin.cloud/ai/about): OpenAI-compatible API at https://iapi.novin.cloud/v1, API keys, models, usage & billing.
- [Mirrors](https://docs.novin.cloud/mirrors/about): Linux, languages, Docker/OCI, DevOps, per-tool guides, all repositories.
- [Wallet](https://docs.novin.cloud/wallet/about) · [Support tickets](https://docs.novin.cloud/support/tickets) · [Account](https://docs.novin.cloud/account/registration)
- [FAQ](https://docs.novin.cloud/getting-started/faq) · [Glossary](https://docs.novin.cloud/getting-started/glossary)

## Related
- [Marketing site](https://novin.cloud) · [Console](https://console.novin.cloud) · [Sitemap](https://docs.novin.cloud/sitemap.xml)
